sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Valuables crate (Rare) (Valuables (Rare)) is a Reward Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Before Unlocking
sections.text: A trophy for participating in Arena battles. Unlike cash, barter will always be viable, and the contents of this box may be more valuable than a few packs of crunchy paper. But first, you need to find a way to open this box.

sections.heading: After Unlocking
sections.text: A trophy for participating in Arena battles. Unlike cash, barter will always be viable, and the contents of this box may be more valuable than a few packs of crunchy paper. The lock has been crudely broken, which means there are no more obstacles between you and the contents of the box.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Can only be opened outside of a raid
  - Must be un-locked at the Workbench level 1 before it can be opened
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
- Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")
- Only the locked version can be stashed in Lucky Scav Junk box

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Possible reward from Ref's daily and weekly quests for Arena

sections.heading: Crafting
sections.text: | Hand drill x1; Hand drill; +; Valuables crate (Rare) x1; Locked Valuables crate (Rare) | → | Workbench level 1; 1 minute | → | Valuables crate (Rare) x1; Unlocked Valuables crate (Rare) |

sections.heading: Loot Table
sections.text: The crate can contain various valuables, info items, keys & keycards and GP coins.
